remedyNotes.A11Y-R-E09-D10-F-32: on SCR-006's read-only window Buy and Sell are CMP-079 RbacGate in its T2 treatment (E09-D09 section 2.2): `aria-disabled="true"`, never `disabled`; a leading CMP-019 Icon `lock` named "Not available"; `aria-describedby` on the reason node that is in the DOM at mount; the reason string is the section 3.1 key `rbac.read_only` ("Read-only after three wrong codes.").

extraFindings.title: `14`:141 lists SCR-001's components without CMP-079 RbacGate or CMP-019 Icon (`lock`), while the Sign in button is blocked while rate-limited (`14` SCR-001 states; E09-D10 F-4; A11Y-F-0001): a state-driven T2 treatment with no component or reason node listed. A catalogue-documentation miss, as E08-D12 F-03 is for SCR-104, not a behaviour finding
extraFindings.remedy: `14`:141 gains "CMP-079 RbacGate, CMP-019 Icon (`lock`)"; the blocked Sign in is `aria-disabled` with `aria-describedby` on the rate-limit line (`Too many attempts. Try again in {mm:ss}.`), which is a state vocabulary entry for E09-D03 to register because no section 3.1 key (`rbac.*`) applies to an unauthenticated user

extraFindings.title: `14`:2389 lists SCR-112's components without CMP-079 RbacGate or CMP-019 Icon (`lock`), while its write controls (change password, re-enrol, regenerate recovery codes, disable two-factor, revoke) degrade in place under E09-D09 section 4 and take T2 reasons when the session is read-only or viewing as another user. A catalogue-documentation miss (as E08-D12 F-03), not a G-T2 behaviour miss
extraFindings.remedy: `14`:2389 gains "CMP-079 RbacGate, CMP-019 Icon (`lock`)"; the write controls are `aria-disabled` with `aria-describedby` on the reason node (in the DOM at mount), with section 3.1 keys `rbac.read_only` ("Read-only after three wrong codes.") and `rbac.view_as` ("Read-only while viewing as {user}.")
